met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over North Pakistan & adjoining Jammu & Kashmir between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level persists with the trough aloft in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 70°E to the north of Lat. 30°N.
The cyclonic circulation over North Haryana & neighbourhood now lies over northwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Comorin area & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from the above cyclonic circulation over Comorin area to Northwest Bay of Bengal off Odisha coast across Gulf of Mannar, Southwest Bay of Bengal extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists. The upper air cyclonic over Central parts of South Rajasthan now lies over southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Uttar Pradesh & adjoining Bihar persists and now lies between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Southeast Bangladesh & neighbourhood persists and now lies at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Central Assam & neighbourhoodbetween 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Central Parts of Keralam & neighbourhoodat 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
